meta.dataset: Anonymised demo dataset: fictional names, synthetic HR records (hr_dummy_dataset.xlsx), dummy KPI/expense/cost data

revenue.name: Revenue booked
revenue.formula: Sum of revenue on closed-won deals in the quarter

ngp.name: Net gross profit (NGP)
ngp.formula: Revenue − direct cost of sale on closed-won deals

renewal_value.name: Renewal value processed on time
renewal_value.formula: Contract value of renewals finalised before deadline

renewal_completion.name: Renewal admin completion
renewal_completion.formula: Renewals finalised before deadline ÷ total renewals due

turnaround.name: Quote turnaround time
turnaround.formula: Average working days from request to issued quote

internal_csat.name: Internal CSAT
internal_csat.formula: Sum of internal survey ratings ÷ maximum possible rating

first_time_right.name: First-time-right quotes
first_time_right.formula: Quotes issued without rework ÷ total quotes

attributed_ngp.name: Attributed NGP
attributed_ngp.formula: Product Management's attributed share of deal NGP

deal_support_win.name: Deal support win rate
deal_support_win.formula: Supported deals won ÷ total supported deals

sla_compliance.name: SLA compliance
sla_compliance.formula: Requests resolved within SLA ÷ total requests

roadmap_on_time.name: Roadmap delivery on time
roadmap_on_time.formula: Roadmap items shipped by committed date ÷ items committed

enablement_sessions.name: Sales-enablement sessions
enablement_sessions.formula: Enablement sessions delivered to Sales in the quarter

chargeable_revenue.name: Chargeable revenue
chargeable_revenue.formula: Billable hours × rate, invoiced in the quarter

delivery_quality.name: Delivery quality score
delivery_quality.formula: Average client quality rating ÷ maximum rating

scoping_turnaround.name: Scoping turnaround
scoping_turnaround.formula: Average working days from request to signed-off scope

dso.name: Days sales outstanding (DSO)
dso.formula: Receivables ÷ revenue × days in period, on owned projects

csat.name: Customer CSAT
csat.formula: Sum of survey ratings ÷ maximum possible rating

on_time.name: On-time delivery
on_time.formula: Milestones delivered on time ÷ milestones delivered

defect_escape.name: Defect escape rate
defect_escape.formula: Defects found after go-live ÷ total defects
